title: CAS-07611 — The Claire Byrne Show — Newstalk 106-108FM
text:
Programme: The Claire Byrne Show
Broadcast / VOD service: Newstalk 106-108FM
Date broadcast or accessed: 05.03.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Code of Programme Standards: Obligation 16.3. Code of Fairness, Objectivity & Impartiality in News and Current Affairs: Obligations 12.2.1 and 14.6.
Short description: The broadcast featured an interview with a human rights lawyer which discussed social media influencers in the UAE. The complaint alleges that the broadcast was not fair, impartial or objective, and claims made by the guest were unchallenged by the presenter.
Outcome: Dismissed
Commission Decision: Dismiss the complaint pursuant to section 48(4)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 21.05.2026
